palette: deep navy blue, slate blue-grey, warm off-white cream, electric blue accent, coral red accent, a touch of gold for money.

shots.prompt: Low-angle view of a young man with short brown hair and a light beard, wearing a blue hoodie, standing confidently on top of a huge mountain of green banknotes and gold coins at night; behind him a giant glowing round screen rises like a moon; at the foot of the money mountain a tiny crowd of people looks up.
Close-up of two hands from the bottom of the frame throwing a fan of plain green banknotes into the air; banknotes fly and spin across the whole frame with soft shadows on a warm cream background.
Planet Earth floating in deep blue space with soft rim light and stars; on the very top of the planet a tiny figure in a blue hoodie plants a small coral red flag; thin orbit lines around the planet.

An enormous stadium seen from high above at dusk, filled with thousands of tiny people holding up glowing phones, rows of seats curving away into the distance, a big empty dark screen hanging over the field.

A big wooden desk seen from directly above with a large paper world map spread on it, a brass magnifying glass, pins, and small paper figures of people crowded on North America and on Russia; soft warm desk-lamp light.

A winners podium with three steps on a dark stage under three spotlights, plus a lower fourth step; the third step glows coral red; confetti falling; heavy curtains in the background; the steps are empty.

A small cozy teenager's bedroom at night: an eighteen-year-old boy in a blue hoodie sits at a desk talking to a webcam on a tripod, desk lamp glow, a window with a dark blue night sky, posters on the wall, an analog wall clock, empty snack wrappers; warm lamp light against cool night tones.
Wide rolling green hills covered with long neat rows of freshly planted young trees, small volunteers with shovels in the distance, soft blue sky with a few clouds, fresh morning light.

A huge outdoor game field seen from above with hundreds of tiny contestants in identical teal tracksuits standing in neat rows; above them hangs a giant transparent piggy bank filled with banknotes, glowing softly.
An open passport lying on a wooden table under warm light, the photo page has an empty photo frame and blank lines, a wooden rubber stamp and an ink pad lie next to it.
Sixteen different people standing in four rows facing the viewer in a soft studio space; exactly one person in the middle wears a coral red sweater, smiles and holds up a small blue passport.
A vintage cash register on a shop counter, its drawer sliding open, gold coins jumping out in arcs, musical notes floating in the air above it, a soft spotlight from above.

A city at night celebrating: colorful fireworks over the rooftops, people on the street with sparklers and small flags, warm windows; on the side of one building hangs a giant calendar page with one day circled in red.
A coral red flag on top of a green hill at sunrise, seen from low in the grass, a small happy crowd walking up the hill towards it, long morning shadows.
